notes.text: Two independently retrieved locations contain the epithet in parallel versions of the mule-blood discussion. Preserve the transliterated Nachota and source many-places assertion. Do not infer profession, migration role or chronology from the epithet, and do not count parallel locations as an exhaustive attestation census.
